Contributing to sacha

Thanks for contributing! This document covers the conventions this package follows so new code stays consistent with existing modules (coldp, core, spatial, inaturalist).

Documentation conventions (roxygen2)

The full rationale for these rules lives in R/sacha-package.R (?sacha after loading the package) — read it once before writing new accessors. Summary:

Plain / _md twin functions

Many accessors ship as a plain-text version and a _md (Markdown-formatted) version meant for use inside a rendered report.

  • Identical signature, output-format-only difference → share one help page with @rdname (see the coldp module).
  • _md has its own parameters, or a different error-handling contract (e.g. a communication failure is silenced in _md but raised as an error in the plain version) → document on separate pages (see gbif_map()/gbif_map_md(), col_locations()/ col_locations_md()).

If you’re unsure which bucket a new pair falls into, write the two functions first — the signature and error behavior will make it obvious.

One-line wrapper families

A family of thin wrappers delegating to one underlying function (e.g. ipni_url(), gbif_url(), col_url(), … → indexation_urls()) gets one shared @rdname page, with a @details table mapping each wrapper to what it fixes. Keep @export on every wrapper; only the documentation is consolidated.

Shared parameters between non-twin functions

If two functions share most parameters but aren’t a plain/_md pair (e.g. inat_images() vs. save_inat_images()), don’t repeat @param blocks — use @inheritParams <reference_function> and document only what’s specific to that function.

Language argument

Every module resolves language dynamically from inst/lang/*.yml. Never hardcode a closed set like language = c("es", "en") with match.arg() — that breaks the “drop a new .yml file to add a language” contract the rest of the package relies on.

Before opening a PR

  • Run devtools::document() and commit the resulting man/*.Rd changes.
  • Run devtools::check() and make sure it’s clean (or that any existing NOTEs are unrelated to your change).
  • If you added or changed a _md twin, confirm in your PR description which bucket above it falls into and why.
